basic_info.description: Stunning flat with brand new features such as a remodeled kitchen, wide plank oak floors and new windows. Open, spacious floor plan, soaring 11' ceilings, and petite deck off the master bedroom. Entire garage goes with unit, big enough for one car and plenty of other storage. With the new windows and being on an Oak downslope the property is surprisingly peaceful. Near all the resturants, shopping and amenities of the Hayes Valley commercial corridor. In a two-unit building for fast track condo conversion (buyer to verify) and Sirkin TIC agreement provided as a courtesy. The other unit 477 Oak is in escrow and waiting for a buyer for this one.
